QuestInfo.name: Enemy Unknown
QuestInfo.0: Only the cabinet with the books you needed were burned and Wiz was possessed by something when you went to investigate. Things are getting stranger by the minute! It's time for a breakdown.
QuestInfo.1:
The records of the war with the Black Mage are definitely under attack. The books in #m220000000# were burned to ash. #rSomeone is erasing the heroes from history on purpose#k.

Wiz's spirit possession is worrisome too. It's good that he came back to his old self, but #bthat weird spirit must have had control of him#k. What could it be?

A whole host of people are out for your blood! It might be a good time to get back to the #b#m150000000##k and regroup.
QuestInfo.2: You told #p1401002# what happened with Wiz. She'll need more information if she's going to figure out who the perpetrator is.

0.0: #m222020000# has every single book in Maple World and a fire starts under the ONLY books having to do with the old heroes? That's more than coincidence.
0.1: It's for certain. #rSomeone is erasing the heroes from history#k.
0.2: What happened to Wiz was terribly odd too. It was a good thing I was there to knock him out, #bbut it seemed like he was being controlled by someone#k.
0.3: A spell like Seduce would be able to control him easily enough, but this thing seemed to have taken him over from the inside. It must be a powerful entity to inhabit a man so fully.
0.4: It stands to reason that the possessor and the history destroyer could be one and the same. It's time I got back to the #b#m150000000##k to tell #b#p1401002##k everything I know.

yes.0: I need to figure out who to go after first, the possessor or the destroyer. Maybe #p1401002# can help me out.

1.0: Captain, you're so pale! I was just joking about you not reading enough. You should go out into the sun once in a while or you'll look like a nerd! \r\n#L0##b(You tell her about everything that happened in #m222020000#.)#l\n#k
1.1: That's some crazy talk, captain, but now I'm sure we're looking at a tamperer extraordinaire! Now all you have to do is find them. \r\n#L0##bCertainly, I just wish I knew what had caused #p2040052#'s transformation. It's troubling.#l\n#k
1.2: It's very odd, I gotta admit. You've got a ton of investigating to do! \r\n#L0##bIt is, but I believe the enemy in front of us is the one we need to focus on. It's not like I can unerase documents that were destroyed a century ago.#l\n#k
1.3: You got that one right. I'm running out of places to look for clues. \r\n#L0##bThen it's settled. Start gathering any information you can find on the force that controlled #p2040052#. I need to know who, and what, I'm up against.#l\n#k
1.4: Aye aye, captain! Ohh, I always wanted to say that. Maybe solving one of these mysteries will give us the answer to the other!

yes.0: I'll let you know when I find something! You just focus on getting tougher. Anybody that can control a librarian that strict can probably give you a wallop.
